ko.title: 네이버가 찾은 오류 31개 중 색이 칠해진 수 (실응답 픽스처 23쌍, 2026-11-16 다시 계산)

en.title: Highlighted errors out of the 31 Naver found (23 real response pairs, recomputed 2026-11-16)
en.note: Fixing either defect alone stops at 18, because both drop the error at the end of a sentence.
